regime_context: TSX thematic momentum ranks show Big Banks as the dominant, broad-based leader (rank 1, durability 0.71) but with a crowded flag. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped drawdown control in this market; ineligible themes (e.g., Gold Miners, Telcom) have weaker trend health. theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the rank-1 eligible theme with broad trend participation (breadth 1.0) and durability above 0.7. The absolute-trend gate supports staying with the leader for drawdown control, while the crowding flag (z=1.16) advises sizing restraint, not a fade.
